name: kinetic-text
blurb: Characters dance and shift positions rhythmically.
description: Text characters animate with varied timing to move vertically, horizontally, or scale, creating a jittery kinetic effect.
use_when: Playful landing pages or interactive demos that want energy without a clear message.
avoid_when: Readability-first contexts — character motion makes text hard to focus on.
a11y: Text is present but animated continuously. No motion preferences respected.
